title: "Regression"

::: {.callout-note title="Teaching outline"}
This chapter introduces the workflow. Apply it with the reviewed variable map and study protocol; the analysis templates are components, not a validated turnkey pipeline.
:::


# Logistic regression

Use for binary outcomes.

Report:

- adjusted odds ratio
- 95% confidence interval
- p-value
- reference category
- sample size
- model specification

# Linear regression

Use when assumptions are appropriate for continuous outcomes.

Always check the distribution and residual behavior.
